name: 运动损伤风险评估（问卷）

map.运动损伤风险评估（问卷）是做什么的？: What does Sports Injury Risk Assessment (Questionnaire) do?
map.如何使用运动损伤风险评估（问卷）？: How do I use Sports Injury Risk Assessment (Questionnaire)?
map.运动损伤风险评估（问卷）适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Sports Injury Risk Assessment (Questionnaire) best for?
map.基于功能性运动筛查(FMS)和运动损伤风险因素的运动损伤风险评估问卷，从运动习惯: A sports injury risk assessment questionnaire based on the Functional Movement Screen (FMS) and injury risk factors, evaluating risk across 5 dimensions: exercise habits, injury history, flexibility, core strength, and recovery management.
map.运动损伤风险评分 = Σ8 项（运动频率/损伤史/热身/柔韧/核心/拉伸/交叉训: Injury risk score = sum of 8 items (exercise frequency / injury history / warm-up / flexibility / core / stretching / cross-training / recovery, each 0 to 5), max 40; 32 or above = low risk, 24-32 = low-moderate, 16-24 = moderate-high, below 16 = high risk.
map.8. 恢复与休息(睡眠7小时+): 8. Recovery and rest (7+ hours of sleep)
map.热身和拉伸是预防运动损伤的关键环节: Warm-up and stretching are key to preventing sports injuries
map.核心力量不足是下肢损伤的重要风险因素: Weak core strength is a major risk factor for lower-limb injuries
map.建议每周至少运动3次，包含有氧和力量训练: Aim for at least 3 workouts per week, combining cardio and strength training
map.交叉训练可避免单一运动带来的重复性损伤: Cross-training helps avoid repetitive-strain injuries from a single activity
map.赛前用问卷筛高危人群。: Screen high-risk groups with a questionnaire before the season.
map.赛季前用问卷筛既往伤与负荷风险，分级安排预防与监测重点。: Before the season, use the questionnaire to screen for prior injuries and load risks, then tier prevention and monitoring priorities.
map.既往伤史 2 分 + 训练量突增 1 分 + 肌力不平衡 1 分 ≥4 分 →: Prior injury 2 pts + sudden training-load spike 1 pt + muscle imbalance 1 pt >= 4 pts -> high risk, extra prevention needed.
map.问卷能替代体检？: Can a questionnaire replace a physical exam?
map.不能，仅初筛，阳性需专业评估。: No, it is only a first screen; positives need professional assessment.
map.问卷高分就一定受伤？: Does a high score mean injury is certain?
map.高分仅提示风险高而非必然受伤，用于优先干预与动态监测，不能据此下定论。: A high score only indicates elevated risk, not certain injury; use it to prioritize intervention and dynamic monitoring, not to draw conclusions.
map.运动损伤风险评估问卷从运动频率、损伤史、热身习惯、柔韧性、核心力量、拉伸习惯、交: The sports injury risk assessment questionnaire evaluates injury risk across 8 dimensions: exercise frequency, injury history, warm-up habits, flexibility, core strength, stretching habits, cross-training, and recovery/rest.
